title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-mar-2026-maya-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML) - prep notes
Owner: Maya Kapoor (product)
Date of sync: 2026-03-04 10:00 PT (30m)
Attendees (expected): Priya (Eng: serving runtime), Liam (Applied ML), Ethan (Infra), Asha (SRE - optional), me (Product)
Goals for this sync:
- Surface major cross-team dependencies for Q2 roadmap (hosted API perf improvements, dedicated autoscale, private deploy onboarding).
- Confirm timeline and gating criteria for rollout of quantized model variants and perf SLOs.
- Identify 2-3 unblockers that need exec attention or temporary resourcing.
- Align on evaluation plan + metrics to prevent regressions (quality vs. latency).
Background/context (short):
- Product proposal: push model quantization and batching improvements into Dedicated v2 to cut per-token cost by ~25% (internal doc: confluence:RF-QUANT-2026). Target: pilot with 2 customers in May.
- Eng constraints: Priya flagged kernel compatibility issues for seq-len > 1024, might need fallback paths or per-customer model pinning.
- Applied ML: Liam wants to run eval harness across our core prompt sets (safety + quality) before shipping quantized variants; needs stable infra for repeatable evals.
Key agenda (rough 15m -> focused):
1) Quick context + priorities (2m)
2) Roadmap checkpoints & dates (5m)
   - Product target: pilot start 2026-05-02, GA 2026-07-01
   - Eng: need kernel verification + fallback by 2026-04-20 to hit pilot
   - ML: evaluation complete by 2026-04-25 (to allow 1 week of triage)
3) Risks / open blockers (8m)
   - Kernel compatibility for seq>1024 (Priya)
   - Eval infra flakiness / reproducibility (Liam)
   - Dedicated capacity scheduling / predictability for pilot customers (Ethan)
   - Customer data/privacy gating for Private deployment customers (legal/compliance dependency)
Pre-reads / ask before meeting (send by EOD 03/02):
- Priya: short note listing which kernels/ops are at risk for quantized paths + estimated effort for fixes (1-2 bullets)
- Liam: quick sample results from eval harness on 1 model x 3 prompts (pass/fail + degradation % if any)
- Ethan: summary of capacity plan for pilot customers (estimate GPU quota + timeline)
Open questions to raise (for timeboxed decisions):
- If kernel fixes slip past 04/20, do we: delay pilot, restrict pilot to seq<=1024 customers, or enable software fallback at higher latency? (need majority preference)
- What is the gating threshold for quality regressions? (Liam suggested max 2% drop in key eval metrics; product needs to confirm)
- Can we carve out 2 dedicated nodes for pilot customers for the duration of pilot? If yes, what is cost impact? (Ethan to quantify)
Notes / rough answers I expect:
- Priya: likely needs 2 sprints (~4 weeks) for kernel fixes unless we accept software fallback. Fallback adds ~30-50ms p99 increase.
- Liam: early evals show small but measurable decrease on hallucination metric on one prompt set (~3%). Might need calibration/temperature tweaks.
- Ethan: capacity likely doable but needs sign-off from finance for temporary reservation; will provide cost estimate.
Action items (to confirm in meeting) - include owner and target date:
- Priya: provide kernel-compatibility note + if software fallback is feasible (due 2026-03-10)
- Liam: run full eval harness across 5 core prompt sets and publish results to confluence (due 2026-04-15)
- Ethan: provide pilot capacity plan and cost estimate (due 2026-03-08)
- Maya (me): update product PRD with decision tree (fallback vs. restrict vs. delay) and customer communication template (due 2026-03-12)
- Asha: add SLO monitoring hooks for new quantized variant (traces/metrics) in observability backlog (due 2026-03-20)
Possible exec escalations if blockers unresolved by 2026-03-15:
- Request 2 temporary eng FTEs for kernel work (eng hiring/contractor)
- Move pilot customers to later cohort to avoid failed pilot experience
Notes-to-self / talking points (informal):
- Emphasize that pilot is about end-to-end experience not just backend perf numbers. We need sample customer journeys (plan to demo with 1 partner).
- Avoid promising GA date unless eng + ML sign off on quality/compatibility checklists.
- Push for a minimal observable set: p50/p90/p99 latency, cost per token, eval delta, rollback criteria.
Misc / deferred topics (don't take time in this sync):
- Long-term model selection / compilation heuristics (defer to infra roadmap deep-dive)
- Billing UX and per-route cost attribution (product ops)
Follow-ups after meeting (what I'll send out):
- Meeting notes + confirmed action owners + due dates (ticket in Jira for each)
- Decision tree and recommended default: prefer software fallback for pilot if perf impact <30ms p99; otherwise restrict to seq<=1024 customers
- Schedule follow-up checkpoint 2 weeks after meeting to review progress (tentative 2026-03-18 10am PT)
Tone notes: keep it pragmatic, surface risk + mitigation options, avoid technical deep-dives in this 30m slot.
Scratchy bits / TODO in doc:
- attach quick eval sample from Liam once received
- link to product PRD (confluence:RF-PROD-QUANT-2026)
- convert action items into Jira tickets after meeting
